title: Persona Experiment Runners
summary: This module provides command-line tools for the entire persona development and evaluation pipeline, from artifact generation and data collection to vector extraction, steering demonstrations, and final validation. It orchestrates various steps to create, analyze, and test persona steering vectors.

nodes.label: Persona Pipeline CLI
nodes.title: Main CLI Entry Point
nodes.description: The primary command-line interface for orchestrating persona development and evaluation tasks, providing access to various pipeline steps and tools.

nodes.label: Generate Trait Artifact
nodes.title: Generate Persona Trait Artifact
nodes.description: Creates a persona trait bundle, including contrast prompts, evaluation questions, and judge rubrics, often leveraging Vertex AI for generation.

nodes.label: Generate Eval Answers
nodes.title: Generate Evaluation Answers
nodes.description: Prompts the Gemma model with positive and negative system prompts to generate baseline answers for evaluation questions, saving them for later analysis.

nodes.label: Generate & Judge Rollouts
nodes.title: Generate and Judge Rollouts
nodes.description: Performs extraction rollouts using Gemma to generate diverse responses, then judges these responses with Vertex AI to filter for high-quality examples.

nodes.label: Extract Persona Vectors
nodes.title: Extract Persona Vectors
nodes.description: Processes filtered rollouts to extract mean hidden states from the Gemma model and computes the persona vector (mean_pos - mean_neg) for each layer.

nodes.label: Sanity Check Vector Projection
nodes.title: Sanity Check Vector Projection
nodes.description: Evaluates how well positive and negative activations project onto the extracted persona vectors, assessing their separation and overall vector quality.

nodes.label: Demonstrate Steering Ramp
nodes.title: Demonstrate Steering Ramp
nodes.description: Shows the effect of persona steering by generating responses with incrementally increasing alpha values applied to a persona vector, illustrating its impact.

nodes.label: A/B Test Steering
nodes.title: A/B Test Persona Steering
nodes.description: Compares text generation with and without persona steering for specific alpha values, providing a direct A/B comparison of the steering's influence on responses.

nodes.label: Validate Persona Pipeline
nodes.title: Validate Persona Pipeline
nodes.description: Runs automated quality gates to assess data sufficiency, vector separation, layer selection, and steering effectiveness, producing a comprehensive validation report.

nodes.label: Sweep Alpha for Coherence
nodes.title: Sweep Alpha vs Coherence
nodes.description: Performs an alpha sweep for specific traits (e.g., sycophancy, chaos) to find optimal alpha scales that maintain model coherence while applying steering.

nodes.label: Benchmark Steering Latency
nodes.title: Benchmark Steering Latency
nodes.description: Measures the latency and performance of sequential persona steering requests to a FastAPI endpoint for various alpha values, aiding in system optimization.

nodes.label: Trait Bundle
nodes.title: Persona Trait Bundle
nodes.description: JSON artifact defining a persona, including contrast prompts, evaluation questions, and judging rubrics, serving as the foundational input for the pipeline.

nodes.label: Eval Answers
nodes.title: Evaluation Answers JSON
nodes.description: JSON file containing model responses to evaluation questions under positive and negative system prompts, used for subsequent analysis and vector extraction.

nodes.label: Rollouts Data
nodes.title: Filtered Rollouts JSONL
nodes.description: JSONL file containing filtered extraction rollouts, which are high-quality model responses used as input for persona vector extraction in later steps.

nodes.label: Persona Vectors
nodes.title: Persona Vectors (.pt)
nodes.description: PyTorch tensor file containing the extracted persona vectors (mean_pos - mean_neg) for different model layers, representing the learned persona direction.

nodes.label: Sanity Eval Report
nodes.title: Sanity Evaluation Report JSON
nodes.description: JSON report detailing the projection of activations onto persona vectors, indicating their separation and providing a sanity check on vector quality.

nodes.label: Steering Ramp Output
nodes.title: Steering Ramp Output JSON
nodes.description: JSON output from the steering ramp demonstration, showing model replies at different alpha values to visualize the gradual effect of persona steering.

nodes.label: Steering A/B Output
nodes.title: Steering A/B Output JSON
nodes.description: JSON output from the A/B steering comparison, showing model replies with and without steering to directly assess the impact of the persona vector.

nodes.label: Validation Report
nodes.title: Validation Report JSON
nodes.description: Comprehensive JSON report summarizing the quality and effectiveness of the developed persona and its steering vectors, including pass/fail verdicts.

nodes.label: Coherence Sweep Report
nodes.title: Coherence Sweep Report JSON
nodes.description: JSON report from the alpha sweep, recommending optimal alpha scales based on coherence metrics to ensure effective and stable persona steering.

nodes.label: Run Manifest
nodes.title: Run Manifest JSON
nodes.description: Metadata file tracking the outputs and key parameters of a persona development run, providing an overview and traceability for the entire pipeline.

nodes.label: Gemma LLM
nodes.title: Gemma Language Model
nodes.description: The large language model (e.g., Gemma) used for generating text, performing rollouts, and extracting internal activations for persona vector creation.

nodes.label: Vertex AI Services
nodes.title: Vertex AI Platform Services
nodes.description: Google Cloud's Vertex AI platform, utilized for LLM calls (e.g., artifact generation) and acting as a judge for evaluating model responses and coherence.

nodes.label: FastAPI Steering API
nodes.title: FastAPI Persona Steering API
nodes.description: An external API endpoint, typically a FastAPI service, that provides persona steering functionality, used for real-time interaction or performance benchmarking.

groups.label: Surface
groups.title: User-Facing Entry Points
groups.description: Components that serve as the primary interface for users to interact with the persona development and evaluation system.

groups.label: Generative Steps
groups.title: Persona Data Generation
groups.description: Components responsible for generating the core data and artifacts required for persona development, including trait definitions and model responses.

groups.label: Analytical & Evaluation
groups.title: Persona Analysis and Validation
groups.description: Components focused on analyzing generated data, extracting persona vectors, performing sanity checks, and validating the overall effectiveness of the persona pipeline.

groups.label: Demonstration & Benchmarking
groups.title: Persona Steering Demonstration
groups.description: Components used to demonstrate the effects of persona steering and to benchmark the performance of the steering mechanism.

groups.label: Data Artifacts
groups.title: Persona Pipeline Data
groups.description: Key data artifacts and intermediate files produced and consumed throughout the persona development and evaluation pipeline.
